name: Lectern 01 · Collect: read each watched board and normalise what it says

parameters.content:
## 01 · Collect
Port of `fetch_board()` and `normalise()` in lectern/collect/collect.py. **Fixture mode** (default) replays three recorded, made-up payloads, one per provider; **live mode** calls the public job-board APIs for the boards in `shared/boards.json`. A board that fails becomes a status row, never a stop. Live: Greenhouse and Ashby only; SmartRecruiters needs its per-posting detail calls (not built), so it is reported as unavailable rather than judged on empty text.

parameters.jsCode: return [{json: {mode: 'fixture'}}];  // change to {mode: 'live'} (optionally only: ['Anthropic']) to read the real boards

const b = $json;
return {json: {provider: b.provider, company: b.company, slug: b.slug, payload: null, error: 'SmartRecruiters needs its per-posting detail calls, not built in n8n yet'}};
